capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Hyundai lists 84 kWh for the 2025 Long Range/XRT; 2027 is the same generation with no pack change reported (Electrek 2026-11-11).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: European listing of the same 84 kWh pack (MY24): 80.0 kWh usable. Pack is shared across markets.

chemistry.notes: EV Database: NMC cathode, pouch (84 kWh pack); SK On NCM 811 per WeeklyDriver (already on file for 2026).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EV Database: 697 V nominal, 800 V architecture.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the US 2026 IONIQ 5 owner's manual (NE1a) describes manual plus navigation-automatic Battery Conditioning; the 2027 car is the same 2025-refresh generation (Electrek 2026-11-11 reports no 2027 charging changes). Years compared: 2025, 2026, 2027.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: US 2026 IONIQ 5 page states 10.9 kW home charging for the 84 kWh car (already on file for 2026); 2027 is the same generation and onboard charger. Source is a US page; no Canadian page states the onboard charger, so Canadian cars on this powertrain (2025-2026) rely on the same carry-over.

dc_max_kw.notes: US 2025 first drive relays a "peak rate of 257 kW" on a 350 kW CCS charger (Hyundai US figure; Wikipedia infobox also 257). Conflicts: EV Database 263 kW (Hyundai Europe claims 260 kW), Wikipedia spec table 238 kW, Car and Driver measured about 258 kW. Estimated for 2027: same hardware as the 2025 car; no charging change reported.
